title: Preferring films to vaudeville
summary: He liked films better than live stage because there was no rush of timed acts.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Well that was pretty much all of your films.
We've gone through all the major motion pictures that you performed in.
How did you feel about motion pictures?

Because you had time to do it and don't have the rush act by the time you get through with it. In vaudeville you have so many minutes to do your act. In pictures you have so many minutes to do a scene.
I didn't have as much to do. That's why. When I like to do something, I can remember it. But when I'm not doing anything and think I should be doing something, I can't remember it.
